findings.finding: The invariant plural adjective produces singular disagreement when exactly one tag is selected.
findings.evidence: intl-messageformat(es), count=1, name=Trabajo: "1 seleccionadas. Agrupar en Trabajo." The picker passes next.length / selected.length as a string, so 1 is a reachable normal state.
findings.recommendation: Use count-neutral wording such as "Selección: {count}. Agrupar en {name}." to preserve existing string-argument call sites, or coordinate numeric count plus ICU pluralization.

findings.finding: The new count plural omits the Spanish many form required for exact multiples of one million. Meaning remains clear, but the resulting count phrase is ungrammatical.
findings.evidence: intl-messageformat(es), count=1000000: "1.000.000 conversaciones"; expected "1.000.000 de conversaciones". The Spanish style guide explicitly requires this category; baseline delete_description already handles it.
findings.recommendation: Add many {# de conversaciones}, retaining one and other.
